name: The Statistical Silence in the Network Log

caie_fractures.description: Network log says bytes=0 but router NetFlow says 47GB. The logging process was compromised to erase the scale of the theft.
System logs contradict the logging process memory. Memory is the structural truth.

peirce_chain.firstness: Network logs with bytes=0 during a peak of massive traffic.
peirce_chain.secondness: Router reports 847 Mbps. Kernel confirms active sockets with manipulated counters. Log compromised.
peirce_chain.thirdness: Habit of compromising the observation layer to hide the scale of the theft, not the event itself.

notes: Eco: the 'void' is the message. Grice: Quantity maxim violation by omission of magnitude.
